scope: The exact toy-v6 fresh-process replay-capture protocol rule represented by the sealed evaluation checkpoint: when a challenge may have launched but the durable record cannot establish whether it did, the possibly launched index must not be retried inside the same generation. The same source couples this rule to invalidating the generation and starting a wholly new precommitted attempt namespace. This grade assesses only the evidence that this narrow no-retry rule is part of the protocol and coherently protects its exact-coverage proof obligation; it does not establish universal exactly-once execution, quantify ambiguous-launch frequency, prove optimality against alternative deduplication designs, or show end-to-end Chat-parity/AGI benefit.

independent_checks.logical_consistency_result: Within the sealed v6 protocol, the final certificate requires exact challenge coverage and later global identity checks. If an index may already have launched but durable evidence cannot establish that fact, retrying the same index under the same generation would make the durable transcript insufficient to prove exact coverage without an additional independent deduplication witness. The no-retry rule is therefore internally coherent as a fail-closed proof-preservation constraint. The source does not establish that no other architecture could safely retry with stronger idempotency or deduplication evidence.

grading.causal_attribution: protocol_structural_rationale_only; no measured ambiguous-launch intervention, duplicate incident, or retry-versus-no-retry counterfactual
grading.reproducibility: strong_for_recovering_the_no_retry_rule_and_its stated preconditions from the exact sealed checkpoint; not_established_for_empirical failure-prevention effect
grading.primary_source_support: exact clean worker checkpoint is the primary source for this role-local protocol rule
grading.uncertainty: The exact source states no_retry_after_ambiguous_launch=true and separately instructs that any duplicate or ambiguous launch invalidates the generation, forbids retry of any possibly launched index, and starts a wholly new precommitted namespace. This is strong primary-source support for the protocol rule and a coherent exact-coverage rationale. The assessed artifact contains no observed ambiguous-launch event, no duplicate produced by a retry, no counterfactual experiment, no measured operational cost, and no comparison with stronger idempotency/deduplication mechanisms. Evidence is therefore solid for the narrow internal invariant but materially weaker for universal necessity or optimality.

phase1_acceptance_boundary: This candidate contributes a narrow duplicate/ambiguity defense for replay-style evaluation capture by forbidding silent retry of possibly launched work when the durable record cannot prove launch status. It does not itself eliminate a Work/protected/manual execution dependency, finite quota dependency, or cost dependency; does not prove useful-outcome parity; does not prove an architecture-independent no-retry theorem; and does not close any Phase-1 row or the root. Remaining current-18 coverage, zero-dependency, zero-quota, zero-cost, usefulness/conflict/authority, replay/resume, and scheduler-persistence gates remain open.
